design: Eighteen previously generated small contracts. No method, seed, ranking, or parameter is changed after the controlled study. Stored references come from prior exhaustive enumeration of 4096 recipient subsets per contract.

methods.FreshRatio: D01 QoDA-inspired comparator, not QoDA reproduction
methods.LPOrder: frozen root-LP order plus checked deletion
methods.ShareFirst: D01 sharing-first lexicographic solver control, not iShare or BIGSHARED reproduction
methods.Random16: best and median of sixteen frozen random orders
